title: "Copepod water and carbon content"
author: "Patrick Pata"
date: "2025-03-13"
output: html_document
---

Get the copepod water and carbon content data from the trait database. Filter for Calanus complex.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

trait.lvl1 <- read.csv("C:/Sync/R Workspace/Zooplankton_trait_database/data_input/Trait_dataset_level1/trait_dataset_level1-2023-08-15.csv")


copepods <- trait.lvl1 %>% 
  filter(majorgroup == "Calanoid") %>% 
  filter(traitName %in% c("carbonPDW","carbonPWW","dryWeightPWW",
                          "lipidPDW")) %>%  #"lipidPWW"
  mutate(traitValue = as.numeric(traitValue)) 
```


Plot dat
```{r}
ggplot(copepods %>% 
         filter(genus %in% c("Calanus", "Neocalanus")), 
       aes(x = scientificName, y = traitValue)) +
  geom_boxplot() + 
  geom_point(shape = 4) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = rev) +
  facet_wrap(~traitName, ncol = 2, scales = "free")

ggsave("calanus_carbon_water_content.png")

ggplot(copepods %>% 
         filter(traitName %in% c("carbonPDW","dryWeightPWW")),
       aes(x = genus, y = traitValue)) +
  geom_boxplot() + 
  geom_point(shape = 4) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = rev) +
  facet_wrap(~traitName, ncol = 2, scales = "free")
  

ggsave("copepod_genus_carbon_content.png")

```
